Values.// App Configuration keys: The settings below mirror platform-reliability-cron-setting and platform-reliability-database-connectionString, with hyphens replaced by underscores. A deployment copies the App Configuration values into env vars of these names; az containerapp rejects env var names outside a-z, A-Z, 0-9 and _.
Values.// platform_reliability_cron_setting: Hotel and cruise journey sync (SyncHotelJourneys, SyncCruiseJourneys). The Functions host resolves it while indexing functions, so it must arrive as an app setting. Never remove it: a missing value fails indexing for every function in the app.
Values.// platform_reliability_database_connect: Copied from App Configuration key platform-reliability-database-connectionString in platform-reliability-appconfig-qa. Do not commit secrets.
Values.// JourneyStore:ConnectionString: Fallback for the key above; leave empty unless you need a second store without touching the App Configuration key name.
Values.// JourneySync: What the per-vertical sync timers query. Domains is hotels and cruises; each timer syncs only its own vertical and skips a domain that is not listed here. Clubs come from brand.Information (the dropdown); ClubId is only the fallback when that table cannot be read. Window/Environment mirror the portal defaults (15m/production). InitialRowCap is the first Customer Journeys read. FilteredRowCap is what the timer stores and what the portal requests after a filter change.
Values.// Insights:*: Application Insights application ids and tenant ids per domain+environment. Hotels prod values are filled for local clone.
Values.// Monitoring:*: Latency Spike Monkey thresholds, all optional (nullable = use the documented default: 5000ms / 5 occurrences / 60min window).
Values.// Monitoring:SqlDetectorDomains: CSV of domains that use the SQL-journey-store-based detector instead of KQL (gradual rollout - see docs/product/latency-spike-doctor-monkey-db-migration-plan-2026-09-21.md). Empty = every domain still uses KQL.
Values.// Monitoring:ShadowDomains: CSV of domains where the OTHER detector also runs a side-by-side dry run (no Finding created) and logs a comparison - Fase 3 validation. Empty = no shadow comparison.
Values.// Monitoring:SettingsWriteSecret: Shared secret required via X-Settings-Write-Secret on PUT /api/settings/latency/{domain} and PUT /api/settings/llm-client; must match JourneyMonitorApi:SettingsWriteSecret on the Web side. Fails CLOSED - empty does NOT disable the check, it rejects every write. This dev-only value matches docker-compose's default so `func start` (no Docker) can also save settings.
Values.// Monitoring:InternalApiSecret: Shared secret required via X-Internal-Api-Secret on GET /api/findings/{id}/doctor-report and POST /api/settings/llm-client/models; must match JourneyMonitorApi:InternalApiSecret on the Web side. Same fail-closed behavior as SettingsWriteSecret.
Values.// DataProtection:KeysDirectory: Where the Doctor Monkey's encrypted GitHub token (monitoring.LlmClientSetting) is decryptable from - see SqlLlmClientSettingsStore. A local temp folder is fine for `func start` (same machine across restarts); docker-compose overrides this to a mounted volume instead.
Values.// ScoutLatency:* / ScoutException:*: One section per detection agent - the latency scout and the exception scout run the same pipeline over different boards and are tuned apart. All optional. Defaults for both: Enabled=true, WindowHours=4, BucketMinutes=5, TakePerClub=3, Vertical=All, ClubFilter=*, InvestigationMinPriorityRank=3, MaxNewCasesPerRun=25, UseLlmAssessment=true, AllowScoutVeto=false.
Values.// ScoutLatency:Enabled: Set to false to stop that scout's 5-minute cycle without a redeploy. The cycle is still recorded (status 'disabled') so a silenced scout stays visible.
Values.// ScoutLatency:InvestigationMinPriority: Board rank that produces an InvestigationPackage. Stays 3 in EVERY environment, production included - rank 2 yields ~350 candidates per cycle and must not be switched on until the real per-investigation cost has been measured.
Values.// ScoutLatency:WindowHours: How far back the board query looks. 4 matches the Azure workbook; 0.25 (15 min) is the cheaper alternative - each query scans the window across three App Insights resources and takes ~40s.
Values.// Ai:GitHubToken: GitHub OAuth token (gho_) for the Doctor Monkey's LLM calls. Never commit a real value - set locally only, e.g. via 'func settings add' or an environment variable.
